commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check runtime, public references, bindings, private integrity, and restored suspension.

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Read public projects, source claims, capabilities, tools, and probes.

commands.name: responsibility
commands.description: Retain an immutable goal, context, exact target, criteria, authority, feature, and lifecycle definition.

commands.name: reconcile
commands.description: Import evidence, inspect current local state, retain findings/repairs, and propose bounded next work.

commands.name: dispatch
commands.description: Resolve an explicit saved destination from fresh discovery, recover private bindings, and return read-only native dispatch advice.

commands.name: briefing
commands.description: Refresh pinned public guidance, optionally check a declared draft, and retain its exact advisory Markdown.

commands.name: probe
commands.description: Publish a proposed Dot onboarding packet with eight probes.

commands.name: maintain
commands.description: Compare or regenerate public references without changing review records.

commands.name: backup
commands.description: Verify and atomically archive a pinned private record/evidence manifest and bindings.

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Verify an archive and restore into a new suspended private home.

properties.statement: Only own project/host bindings with exact target identity establish a local route.
Concurrent definition heads survive and block action proposals.
Same responsibility, target, effect and occurrence retain the same effect key across review time and definition edits.
Absent, wrong-scope or expired authority cannot authorize work proposals.
Foreign, future, stale, partial or unavailable observations remain ineligible.
Live review cutoffs include requested time and actual completion while fixed historical replay keeps its supplied time.
Owned-group signalling distinguishes absent groups, denied cleanup and unexpected errors without claiming unknown cleanup succeeded.
Imported reports cannot satisfy observed-local criteria or authenticate independent review.
A later pass, weaker definition or earlier native completion cannot erase a retained failure or silence required attention.
Closure requires the exact finding/failure, current expected subject and every original criterion recheck.
Identical sorted evidence manifests/time/rules produce identical reconciliation results under permutation.
Newest actual local identity/bytes cannot borrow an older green result.
Known pending, uncertain or uncorrelated native tasks require rediscovery; partial inventories cannot prove absence and unkeyed completion cannot prove an intended effect.

Independent coordinator and destination identities, fresh project/source evidence, exact destination/remote-host scope, recorded settings and creator lineage gate bounded dispatch advice without erasing launch uncertainty or reused child bindings.
Missed runs require fresh complete post-window coverage; no-op and delivery gaps remain distinct.
Unsuperseded enabled readbacks keep native disablement pending and retirement stops proposals.
Every imported publication prefix is dependency-complete and supersession stays within scope.
Restored homes require current fresh exact target, authority, task and schedule observations in their new epoch; cloud targets remain reported and local targets require inspection.
